summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2M.3 created exactly one new HMIC v1.7/38 CertificationRecord (certification_id=de110d41e6e094b55b3455e31f7dd5e17db8bbaa1e9a045d8920adc431de1609) on hac-dell via the governed scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py create ceremony, run as the Protected Admin (root) OS principal against the deployed source at commit 4efcb255ca5340224f0278f724b939d794a553ca (unchanged from 2M.2, freshly re-verified clean at phase entry -- 10 intervening Mac commits since deployment classified NON-AUTHORITY GOVERNANCE/REPORTING via git diff --stat against src//scripts//contracts/ returning empty, so no redeployment was required). This is the first phase in this lineage to exercise successor-certification-creation while an old CertificationRecord AND an old active CertificationBinding both already exist (distinct from 149O.20L.7O.2K.3's first-ever creation with no prior binding) -- independently proved permitted from current source/contract (HMIC-REQ-086/087/088/090; _append_certification_record never reads or checks certification-bindings.json) and exercised via 6 new disposable tmp_path-isolated tests (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2m_3_hac_dell_hmic_v1_7_38_certificationrecord_creation_create_only.py) covering successor-create-allowed, old-record-unchanged, binding-untouched, validator-remains-mismatch, duplicate-create-idempotent, and conflicting-id-fails-closed -- all 6 passed in isolation before the real-host ceremony ran. All authority-sensitive fields (repository_instance_id=0107866f-af7c-40b4-8317-74e71acb05ca, canonical_deployment_root=/opt/pcae/runtime/src, implementation_commit=4efcb255ca5340224f0278f724b939d794a553ca, implementation_scope_digest=3b076a639b9f1b0c55facfd1a721d59d92a377d4bb63dce920843264e873a68e, 7 contract_versions) were independently re-derived live on Dell as root (trust-store files are root:root mode 0600, unreadable by pcae -- confirmed live via PermissionError) immediately before write, matching the precomputed target exactly. verification_record_digest (3ab2634a42411ad941037caa98801e9397bbf4bb270772631f0e2f811234f2db) was freshly computed by the tool itself from 149O.20L.7O.2M.1's own independent-verification report, confirmed byte-identical between the Mac repository and the Dell-deployed copy at the exact same path -- never reused from the prior (v1.6) certification's own verification_record_digest. A fresh Protected Admin election and human confirmation (certified_by=Atila Madai) were obtained directly for this exact target tuple, distinct from 2M.2's redeployment CHGR, 2K.3's create election, and 2K.5's activation election. Post-create: certifications.json contains exactly 2 records -- the old v1.6/36 record field-for-field unchanged, and the new v1.7/38 record matching the precomputed target exactly; certification-bindings.json remains byte-identical, still pointing to the OLD certification_id (2e5f861249d8e70bff53ba2f371d84e37e14eff0bbfcd939902fa7b47d236bd7); the production validator re-run as root remains IMPLEMENTATION_MISMATCH; HMIC readiness remains FALSE; HATP remains NOT READY/NOT ACTIVE; the trust-store directory listing confirms no HardwareCredentialRecord/Principal/Signer/DeploymentBinding file exists; no FIDO2/PIV hardware was touched. Fast Green: two full non-tail-truncated python -m pytest -n auto -m fast_green runs were compared -- baseline (this phase's test file stashed via git stash push -u) 334 failed/8578 passed/4 skipped/9 errors, vs working tree (test file restored) 335 failed/8583 passed/4 skipped/9 errors; the new test file's own 6 tests were independently re-run in isolation under -n auto and all 6 passed, confirming the +1 failed delta is pre-existing suite flakiness (one previously-passing baseline node flipped), not attributable to this phase's change; the 334/335-scale failure count itself is pre-existing baseline debt comparable in magnitude to 2M.2's own recorded baseline (333 failed), unrelated to and out of scope for this narrow create-only phase. Zero attributable source/logic regressions from this phase's own change. Recommends a separate activation-only successor phase.
